text:
[Council File 26-1358]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT and HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEES’ REPORT relative to a Master License Agreement with the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health (DPH) to utilize City-owned property for the Medical Countermeasures (MCM) Program.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE the General Services Department (GSD) to negotiate and execute a new Master License Agreement with the DPH to administer the MCM Program during emergency situations at City of Los Angeles, GSD-controlled properties under the terms and conditions substantially outlined in the Municipal Facilities Committee (MFC) report dated September 25, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The MFC reports that there is no impact to the General Fund to execute the Master License Agreement. The DPH will pay zero rent under this proposed Agreement, as the MCM Program provides a mutual public benefit. Any City costs associated with the emergency activation and use of a site will be determined on a case-by-case basis to include, but not limited to, security services, staffing for site access and closure, continued facility maintenance, and any other mutually agreed upon expense.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 23, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026
summary: A license agreement letting Los Angeles County Public Health use a City-owned property for its Medical Countermeasures Program.
